request.project_task: Build a university course registration portal.
request.project_goal: Let students enroll while enforcing prerequisites and capacity.
request.project_description: Students search courses, enroll or join a waitlist, and drop future courses.

functional_requirements.text: A student searches courses by term and subject.

atoms.text: A student searches courses by term and subject.

functional_requirements.text: A student enrolls in an eligible course.

atoms.text: A student enrolls in an eligible course.

functional_requirements.text: A student joins a waitlist when a course is full.

atoms.text: A student joins a waitlist when a course is full.

functional_requirements.text: A student drops a future course.

atoms.text: A student drops a future course.

non_functional_requirements.text: Enrollment updates must be serializable to prevent oversubscription.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: A university student who searches, enrolls in, waitlists for, and drops courses.

actors.name: Course Registration System
actors.description: The CourseSelect portal that enforces prerequisites and capacity.

use_cases.name: Search Courses
use_cases.goal: Find courses offered in a given term and subject.
use_cases.trigger: Student initiates a course search by term and subject.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.

success_postconditions.text: The system displays a list of courses matching the selected term and subject.

failure_postconditions.text: The system displays an error or empty result message when no courses match.

main_success_scenario.name: Student searches courses by term and subject

steps.action: Student selects a term and subject and submits the search.
steps.expected_result: Search request is sent to the system.

steps.action: System retrieves courses matching the selected term and subject.
steps.expected_result: Matching courses are identified.

steps.action: System displays the list of matching courses.
steps.expected_result: Student sees courses available for the selected term and subject.

steps.action: System finds no courses matching the selected term and subject.
steps.expected_result: No matching courses are found.

steps.action: System displays a message indicating no courses were found.
steps.expected_result: Student is informed that no courses match the search.

user_stories.capability: search courses by term and subject
user_stories.benefit: I can find courses I am interested in enrolling in.

system_stories.system_action: Retrieve and display courses matching the selected term and subject.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide accurate search results based on term and subject filters.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Search Courses
Goal: Find courses offered in a given term and subject.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student initiates a course search by term and subject.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Student selects a term and subject and submits the search.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] System retrieves courses matching the selected term and subject.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System displays the list of matching courses.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: No courses match search criteria
Source FRs: FR-001

use_cases.name: Enroll in Course
use_cases.goal: Enroll in an eligible course after prerequisite and capacity checks.
use_cases.trigger: Student selects a course and requests enrollment.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.
The student has selected a course for enrollment.

success_postconditions.text: The student is enrolled in the course and the course capacity is decremented.

failure_postconditions.text: The student is not enrolled and is informed of the reason (prerequisite or capacity failure).

main_success_scenario.name: Student enrolls in an eligible course

steps.action: Student requests to enroll in a selected course.
steps.expected_result: Enrollment request is sent to the system.

steps.action: System checks whether the student meets the course prerequisites.
steps.expected_result: Prerequisite check passes.

steps.action: System checks remaining capacity for the course.
steps.expected_result: Capacity check passes (seats available).

steps.action: System enrolls the student in the course and updates capacity.
steps.expected_result: Student is enrolled and capacity is decremented.

steps.action: System confirms successful enrollment to the student.
steps.expected_result: Student receives enrollment confirmation.

alternative_scenarios.name: Course is full; student joins waitlist

steps.action: System determines the course has no remaining capacity.
steps.expected_result: Capacity check fails.

steps.action: System offers the student the option to join the waitlist.
steps.expected_result: Student is prompted to join the waitlist.

steps.action: Student accepts and joins the waitlist.
steps.expected_result: Student is added to the waitlist for the course.

steps.action: System confirms waitlist placement to the student.
steps.expected_result: Student receives waitlist confirmation.

steps.action: System determines the student does not meet the course prerequisites.
steps.expected_result: Prerequisite check fails.

steps.action: System denies enrollment and informs the student of the missing prerequisites.
steps.expected_result: Student is not enrolled and receives prerequisite failure message.

user_stories.benefit: I can secure a seat in a course I am qualified for.

system_stories.system_action: Check prerequisites and capacity, then enroll the student if eligible.
system_stories.responsibility: Enforce prerequisite and capacity rules during enrollment.

system_stories.system_action: Serialize enrollment updates to prevent oversubscription.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Enroll in Course
Goal: Enroll in an eligible course after prerequisite and capacity checks.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student selects a course and requests enrollment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The student has selected a course for enrollment.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Student requests to enroll in a selected course.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System checks whether the student meets the course prerequisites.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] System checks remaining capacity for the course.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] System enrolls the student in the course and updates capacity.
  5. [STEP-UC002-005] System confirms successful enrollment to the student.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-ALT-001: Course is full; student joins waitlist
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Prerequisite not met
Source FRs: FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005

use_cases.name: Join Waitlist
use_cases.goal: Join a waitlist for a full course.
use_cases.trigger: Student requests to join a waitlist for a full course.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.

success_postconditions.text: The student is placed on the waitlist for the course.

failure_postconditions.text: The student is not added to the waitlist and is informed of the reason.

main_success_scenario.name: Student joins waitlist for a full course

steps.action: Student requests to join the waitlist for a full course.
steps.expected_result: Waitlist request is sent to the system.

steps.action: System verifies the course is full and the student is eligible to waitlist.
steps.expected_result: Waitlist eligibility confirmed.

steps.action: System adds the student to the waitlist.
steps.expected_result: Student is placed on the waitlist.

steps.action: System confirms waitlist placement to the student.
steps.expected_result: Student receives waitlist confirmation.

steps.action: System determines the waitlist is not available for the course.
steps.expected_result: Waitlist option is unavailable.

steps.action: System informs the student that the waitlist is not available.
steps.expected_result: Student is notified and not added to the waitlist.

user_stories.capability: join a waitlist when a course is full
user_stories.benefit: I can have a chance to enroll if a seat becomes available.

system_stories.system_action: Add the student to the waitlist for a full course.
system_stories.responsibility: Manage waitlist placement for full courses.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Join Waitlist
Goal: Join a waitlist for a full course.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student requests to join a waitlist for a full course.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.
  - PRE-UC003-002: The selected course is full.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Student requests to join the waitlist for a full course.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] System verifies the course is full and the student is eligible to waitlist.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] System adds the student to the waitlist.
  4. [STEP-UC003-004] System confirms waitlist placement to the student.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Waitlist not available
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: Drop Course
use_cases.trigger: Student requests to drop a future course.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.
The student is enrolled in a future course.

success_postconditions.text: The student is dropped from the course and capacity is incremented.

failure_postconditions.text: The student remains enrolled and is informed of the reason.

steps.action: Student requests to drop a future course.
steps.expected_result: Drop request is sent to the system.

steps.action: System verifies the course is in the future and the student is enrolled.
steps.expected_result: Drop eligibility confirmed.

steps.action: System drops the student from the course and updates capacity.
steps.expected_result: Student is dropped and capacity is incremented.

steps.action: System confirms the drop to the student.
steps.expected_result: Student receives drop confirmation.

exception_scenarios.name: Course is not in the future

steps.action: System determines the course is not a future course.
steps.expected_result: Drop eligibility fails.

steps.action: System denies the drop and informs the student.
steps.expected_result: Student remains enrolled and is notified.

user_stories.benefit: I can adjust my schedule before the course begins.

system_stories.system_action: Drop the student from a future course and update capacity.
system_stories.responsibility: Process course drops for future courses.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Drop Course
Goal: Drop a future course enrollment.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student requests to drop a future course.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: The student is authenticated in CourseSelect.
  - PRE-UC004-002: The student is enrolled in a future course.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Student requests to drop a future course.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] System verifies the course is in the future and the student is enrolled.
  3. [STEP-UC004-003] System drops the student from the course and updates capacity.
  4. [STEP-UC004-004] System confirms the drop to the student.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC004-EXC-001: Course is not in the future
Source FRs: FR-006
